meta.name: migrate-memory
meta.description: Migrate legacy NanoClaw and Claude-native memory into the shared memory tree and provider-neutral standing instructions. Run after an update reports the shared-memory breaking change, or when a group still has .seed.md, legacy CLAUDE.md/CLAUDE.local.md, Claude auto-memory, or an unindexed imported-agent-memory.md. Triggers on "migrate memory", "legacy memory", "the agent forgot everything after the switch".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将旧版记忆迁移到共享记忆树和持久指令
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果升级后智能体记忆失效或仍有旧版记忆文件
copy.tagline_en: Migrate legacy memory to shared memory tree and standing instructions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your agent forgot everything after a shared-memory breaking change

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会扫描并迁移旧版记忆文件（如 .seed.md、CLAUDE.md 等）到共享记忆树中，并整理为结构化概念，同时更新指令文件。迁移过程分阶段进行，确保安全且可回滚。
howto.when: 当你说出“migrate memory”、“legacy memory”或“the agent forgot everything after the switch”等触发词时，或者当系统检测到旧版记忆文件时触发。

say.text: 检查并迁移遗留的 CLAUDE.md 文件。
say.note: 指定迁移特定旧版文件。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude scans and migrates legacy memory files (e.g., .seed.md, CLAUDE.md) into the shared memory tree, organizing them into structured concepts and updating instruction files. The migration proceeds in stages, ensuring safety and rollback capability.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "migrate memory", "legacy memory", or "the agent forgot everything after the switch", or when the system detects legacy memory files.

say_en.text: Check and migrate legacy CLAUDE.md files.
say_en.note: Specifies migration of a particular legacy file.
